note: Small motel with an RV park on US-30 at the west edge of Potter: open grassy and gravel sites on a loop west of the motel, a few windbreak trees. The Union Pacific main line runs just across the highway, so trains day and night. Pets OK; overnighters welcome. --Claude
summary: Point of Rocks passes the private gate on presence (active Facebook page with August 2026 posts, Google 4.7 over 83 reviews, phone) and price tier (RV Life $$, avg $30; directories $25-35), but no dated operator rate exists, so no fees were written. Recent reviews (2026) confirm level gravel full-hookup sites and constant train noise. Nothing in the fields changed; note cleaned (the railroad is Union Pacific, not BNSF).
